'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2023 Nigerien crisis]]
**The [[French Armed Forces]] confirms that 1,500 troops will leave [[Niger]] by the end of the year, following the [[National Council for the Safeguard of the Homeland|military junta]]'s request. [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2023/10/20/french-troops-to-leave-niger-by-year-s-end-says-general_6191450_4.html (AFP via ''Le Monde'')]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***[[Evacuations during the Israel–Hamas war]]
****[[Israel]] announces the total [[emergency evacuation|evacuation]] of [[Kiryat Shmona]], a city of 20,000 near [[Blue Line (withdrawal line)|the border]] with [[Lebanon]], amid increasing tensions with the militant group [[Hezbollah]]. [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-769416 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
***[[Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis]]
****[[Hamas]] releases two [[Americans|American]] [[hostage]]s following [[mediation]] by [[Egypt]] and [[Qatar]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20231020-hamas-releases-two-us-hostages-with-hope-for-more (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Battle of Avdiivka (2022–present)|Battle of Avdiivka]]
***Ukrainian forces repel [[Russian forces]] from [[Avdiivka]], [[Donetsk Oblast]], saying it has destroyed at least 175 vehicles, including 55 [[tank]]s. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/davidaxe/2023/10/20/the-russians-may-have-lost-55-tanks-in-one-day-trying-and-failing-to-capture-avdiivka/?sh=40f4d7c86912 (Forbes)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of Colombia]], [[Foreign relations of the State of Palestine]]
**[[President of Colombia|Colombian President]] [[Gustavo Petro]] announces the establishment of an [[List of diplomatic missions of Colombia|embassy]] to the [[State of Palestine]] in [[Ramallah]] in the [[West Bank]], and also announces [[humanitarian aid]] to the [[Gaza Strip]] amid the ongoing war. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/colombia-to-open-embassy-in-palestine-president/3026761 (AA)]
*[[Foreign relations of Italy]], [[Foreign relations of the State of Palestine]]
**[[Italian Prime Minister]] [[Giorgia Meloni]] tells the [[Cairo]] Peace Summit the international community must avoid an escalation in the war in Gaza and set a roadmap towards a [[two-state solution]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/20/israel-gaza-war-live-hamas-releases-two-american-captives-from-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Foreign relations of Greece]], [[Foreign relations of the State of Palestine]]
**[[Greek Prime Minister]] [[Kyriakos Mitsotakis]] calls for a new [[peace process]] envisioning an independent [[State of Palestine]] alongside [[Israel]], saying "no military intervention can replace a viable political solution". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/10/20/israel-gaza-war-live-hamas-releases-two-american-captives-from-gaza (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[October 2023 Speaker of the United States House of Representatives election]]
**The [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] majority fails to deliver enough votes for [[Jim Jordan]] to become [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|House Speaker]] on the third vote, with Jordan also losing a subsequent secret [[ballot]] among Republican members, thereby ending his nomination. [https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/house-speaker-vote-10-20-23/index.html (CNN)]
